doc.api

Query the eda namespace (static editor API) progressively (surface / class / method)

Lists the classes on its own; --class-name narrows it to one class, --method-name to a single method.

Usage:
  lceda-pro doc api [--class-name <undefined>] [--method-name <undefined>]

Options:
  --class-name  Class / group name under the eda namespace
  --method-name  Method / interface name

Examples:
  # list every class
  lceda-pro doc api
  # list one class's methods
  lceda-pro doc api --class-name DMT_Board
  # show one method in detail
  lceda-pro doc api --class-name DMT_Board --method-name createBoard

Global flags: see "lceda-pro --help"
